native_result.query: In the PCA conducted on forms of capital, analyzed in hundred-year time slices, how are the symbolic capital components such as house size, daggers, and hatchets/swords characterized in terms of their values on the first principal component (PC1) and distribution across the second principal component (PC2)?
native_result.HypoA: Symbolic capital components such as house size, the number of daggers, and hatchets/swords are characterized by negative values on the first principal component (PC1) and exhibit a wide distribution of values on the second principal component (PC2). This Principal component analysis (PCA) is on the forms of capital. The values of the individual elements of the forms of capital form the attributes.
native_result.HypoB: En el PCA de las 12 formas de capital en cortes de 100 años (capital.csv, 39 bins de 4300-500 BCE, re-estandarizado; PC1 = 30.33% y PC2 = 19.47% de la varianza, 49.79% acumulado, 4 componentes por Kaiser), los componentes de capital simbolico -House Size, Daggers y Hatchets/Swords- tienen cargas POSITIVAS de magnitud intermedia en PC1 (Hatchets & Swords +0.299 rango 5/12, Daggers +0.266 rango 6/12, House Size +0.225 rango 10/12): comparten el signo del polo positivo liderado por Copper & Gold (+0.407), Pottery Decoration (+0.382) y Depot (+0.340), se oponen a Pottery Form (-0.353), Axes & Celts (-0.242), Amber (-0.239) y Sickle (-0.149), pero no definen PC1 (aportan el 21.0% de sus cuadrados frente al 25% esperable con pesos iguales). En PC2 no forman un bloque simbolico coherente: solo House Size carga de forma relevante (+0.327, 5a de 12), alineada con Axes & Celts (+0.471), Amber (+0.444), Monument Size (+0.391), Pottery Form (+0.383) y Monument Count (+0.293), mientras Daggers (+0.074) y Hatchets/Swords (+0.054, la carga mas baja de toda la matriz en PC2) quedan cerca de cero; la similitud coseno en el plano PC1-PC2 es 0.996 entre Daggers y Hatchets/Swords pero solo 0.767 y 0.704 con House Size. Por tanto el capital simbolico no es un factor unitario: las armas siguen el eje general de intensificacion del registro (PC1, que aumenta hacia la Edad del Bronce, r = -0.82 con el ano en BCE, maximo en 1100 BCE, y correlaciona con las tres series, r = 0.43-0.57), mientras el tamano de casa se disocia y se asocia a un segundo eje (PC2, sin tendencia cronologica, r = 0.07; r con House Size = 0.50) de monumentalidad y prestigio visible. El patron es estable entre 39 y 37 bins, con y sin re-estandarizacion y con las series anuales interpoladas (mismos signos; |delta| <= 0.073 en PC1), pero con n = 39 no puede afirmarse que las cargas en PC2 del trio simbolico difieran de cero (ningun intervalo bootstrap de 95% excluye el cero), ni que la composicion de PC2 sea estable (r = 0.77/0.66 con la solucion principal), ni ninguna relacion causal: PC1 esta saturado por el tiempo (r = -0.82) y podria reflejar la intensidad/visibilidad acumulativa del registro, y PC1+PC2 solo capturan 8-16% de la varianza de cada serie simbolica.

sub_hypo.text: Symbolic capital indicators have intermediate positive PC1 loadings, but do not define PC1.
sub_hypo.context: PCA of 12 capital Z-value series in capital.csv, re-standardized across 39 century bins spanning 4300–500 BCE. PCA uses SVD on the correlation matrix, with the largest absolute loading on each axis made positive. PC1 explains 30.33% of variance, PC2 19.47%, and together 49.79%; four components meet the Kaiser criterion.
sub_hypo.relations: PC1 loadings are +0.299 for Hatchets/Swords (absolute-loading rank 5/12), +0.266 for Daggers (6/12), and +0.225 for House Size (10/12). They share the positive pole led by Copper/Gold (+0.407), Pottery Decoration (+0.382), and Depot (+0.340), opposing Pottery Form (-0.353), Axes/Celts (-0.242), Amber (-0.239), and Sickle (-0.149). The symbolic trio contributes 21.0% of PC1 squared loadings, below the 25% expected under equal weights.

sub_hypo.text: The symbolic capital indicators do not form a coherent block on PC2: House Size aligns with monumental and visible-prestige indicators, whereas the weapon indicators load near zero.
sub_hypo.context: PC2 of the re-standardized 39-bin, 12-variable capital.csv PCA, covering 4300–500 BCE.
sub_hypo.relations: House Size loads +0.327 on PC2 (rank 5/12), aligned with Axes/Celts (+0.471), Amber (+0.444), Monument Size (+0.391), Pottery Form (+0.383), and Monument Count (+0.293). Daggers (+0.074) and Hatchets/Swords (+0.054, the lowest absolute PC2 loading) are near zero. In the PC1–PC2 plane, cosine similarity is 0.996 between Daggers and Hatchets/Swords, compared with 0.767 between Daggers and House Size and 0.704 between Hatchets/Swords and House Size.

sub_hypo.text: Symbolic capital is not a unitary factor: weapons follow the general record-intensification axis, while House Size is additionally associated with a second axis of monumentality and visible prestige.
sub_hypo.context: PC1 and PC2 scores and symbolic capital series across the 39 century bins from 4300 to 500 BCE.
sub_hypo.relations: PC1 increases toward the Bronze Age, correlates with BCE year at r = -0.82, peaks at 1100 BCE, and correlates with each symbolic series at r = 0.43–0.57. PC2 has no chronological trend (r = 0.07 with BCE year) and correlates with House Size at r = 0.50, distinguishing house size from the closely aligned weapon indicators.

sub_hypo.text: The symbolic-capital loading pattern is robust to excluding back-filled bins, omitting re-standardization, and using annually interpolated series averaged within century bins.
sub_hypo.context: Sensitivity comparisons against the principal 39-bin PCA: 37 real bins excluding two back-filled rows, a PCA without re-standardization, and PCA using annual *_inter series averaged by bin; component signs are aligned to the principal solution. The 12 capital Z-value series exactly match the century-level subset of time_series_data.csv.
sub_hypo.relations: Loading signs remain unchanged across sensitivity analyses, with absolute PC1 loading differences no greater than 0.073. However, correlations of 0.77/0.66 with the principal PC2 solution do not establish stability of PC2 composition.

sub_hypo.text: The apparent PC2 differentiation of symbolic capital does not establish nonzero population loadings, and the first two components provide limited representation of each symbolic series.
sub_hypo.context: The principal PCA has n = 39 century bins; uncertainty is assessed using 2,000 bootstrap resamples of bins and 95% confidence intervals for the symbolic trio's loadings.
sub_hypo.relations: None of the symbolic trio's PC2 loading bootstrap 95% confidence intervals excludes zero. PC1 and PC2 together capture only 8–16% of the variance of each symbolic series.

sub_hypo.text: The PCA associations do not establish causal relationships; PC1 may reflect cumulative intensity or visibility of the archaeological record rather than a distinct symbolic-capital factor.
sub_hypo.context: Interpretation of the re-standardized 12-capital PCA across 39 century bins spanning 4300–500 BCE.
sub_hypo.relations: PC1 is strongly associated with time (r = -0.82 with BCE year), limiting causal interpretation of its associations with symbolic capital. Cumulative record intensity or visibility is a possible interpretation, not an established causal mechanism.
